name: Regex Tester
summary: Show every match of a regex in some text, with its groups.
description: Adds a Test permission and a test command. Type `/regex \d+ :: a1 b22`, or write a `regex` code block with the pattern on the first line and the text below it, then press Run. Lists each match with its position and capture groups. Matching is linear-time, so a hostile pattern cannot run away, and oversized patterns are refused.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: Test regexes
permissions.description: Run a regex against text in this space.

extension_points.name: test
extension_points.description: Match the pattern on the first line against the text after it.
